content: अभिनिविश् €6 <ab>Ā.</ab> अभिनिविशश्च (<ls>P. I. 4. 47</ls>) .²1 .³({%a%}) To enter into, be settled in; to occupy, set foot in. .³({%b%}) To take possession of, resort to, be attached to (with <ab>acc.</ab>); अभिनिविशते सन्मार्गम् <ls>Sk.</ls> takes to, follows, a good path; सैव धन्या गणिकादारिका यामेवं भवन्मनोऽमिनिविशते <ls>Dk. 57</ls>; <ls>Mu. 5. 12</ls>; <ls>Bk. 8. 80</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To make one enter or occupy, lead, carry or conduct to; (<ab>fig.</ab>) apply, direct or turn (as mind, heart <ab>&c.</ab>) towards something; प्रतिबन्धवत्स्वपि विषयेषु आभिनिवेश्य <ls>M. 3</ls>; <ls>Śi. 1. 15</ls>.
